description: stackup hooks — ask whether work should ship as a stack of dependent pull requests, at the two moments the answer is still cheap. PostToolUse(Write|Edit|MultiEdit) fires after a plan file lands and asks for the layers while the dependency graph is fresh. PreToolUse(Bash) fires before a pull request opens as the last catch for work that never went through a plan. Both are command hooks: they decide mechanically and emit additionalContext only when the condition holds, so the model is not run on every write or every shell command. Neither ever blocks.
